Cleanup reminders

Protect volunteers and waterways

  • Coordinate with barangay officials before organizing work.
  • Use gloves, boots, and appropriate protective equipment.
  • Never enter moving floodwater or unstable drains.
  • Separate and dispose of collected waste properly.
  • Record locations that still need inspection.

Safety reminders

01
Before heavy rain

Clear nearby drainage where safe and prepare essential supplies.

02
During flooding

Move to safer, higher ground when needed. Stay away from fast-moving water and downed power lines.

03
Use trusted information

Follow official announcements and emergency instructions from local authorities.

Data management

Records are stored only in this browser using local storage.

Export a CSV backup before clearing the demo data. This prototype has no user accounts, server, shared database, or automatic notifications.

System scope

Available in this prototype

Local report entry, status updates, cleanup logs, notices, sample map pins, and CSV export.

Needed for a live system

Backend database, secure accounts and roles, real geolocation/map integration, verified weather data, notification delivery, backups, and an official response workflow.
